subject: Post-call recap & quick ask: economic buyer + budget owner
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & quick ask: economic buyer + budget owner

Hi Sam — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a small ask on next steps.

Recap (high level):
- Use case: Acme will use Redwood for document ingestion + private LLM inference to drive customer support automation and internal knowledge search.
- Decision criteria: latency under 200ms p95 for short queries, predictable monthly spend, SOC2/compliance and private deployment option.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q2 and production rollout in Q3 if pilot meets latency and cost targets.

Open items / asks:
1) Can you please intro the economic buyer and the budget owner (who signs the budget/PO)? For deals of this size at Acme you mentioned Finance involvement — if that is Jessica or someone else, looping them in will help speed approvals.
2) Procurement artifacts we should expect (SOW/PO process, standard contract redlines, security questionnaire).

Proposed next steps:
- Intro email to economic buyer + budget owner so we can align on pilot scope and budget.
- 30-min call next week to walk Jessica/Finance and procurement through the mutual action plan and preliminary pricing.

I attached a 1-page call recap and a mutual action plan (editable) to help frame the pilot. If you can introduce Jessica and procurement, I'll propose 2-3 meeting times.

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

--Attachments:

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick ask: economic buyer + budget owner

Marissa — thanks for the recap, that looks right. Looping in the folks who need to be on this:

Introducing Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@acme-corp.com>, Director of Finance — Jessica is the final approver for capital and operational budgets over ~$100k. Also cc'ing procurement (procurement@acme-corp.com) who will own contract and PO logistics.

A couple quick notes to help with the intro call:
- Ballpark budget: for an initial pilot like we discussed I expect Acme to allocate in the $40k-$80k range, with scaling to a $200k+ run rate if the pilot demonstrates unit-cost savings.
- Timeline: Finance needs a clear pilot scope and success metrics to approve the initial spend; procurement typically needs ~2-3 weeks for standard SOW and PO once terms are agreed.
- Decision factors: cost per inference, security/compliance posture, and ability to run in our VPC.

Jessica / procurement / Marissa — happy to schedule a 30-min sync next week. Jessica, Marissa will send a short one-pager and the mutual action plan.

Sam
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
s.torres@acme-corp.com
